US20260310422.title: SELF-SUSTAINING DEEP LEARNING SOFTWARE ENVIRONMENT
US20260310422.abstract: [0000]    A self-sustaining software environment is disclosed, leveraging machine learning (ML) and artificial intelligence (AI) to address software errors in real time. This technology pertains to computer systems, specifically enhancing software reliability through dynamic trail navigation. The technical problem addressed is the frequent occurrence of software errors that disrupt user experience and business operations. The solution involves a framework that constructs and navigates alternative trails for software processes, ensuring seamless operation without user interface disruption. The system employs ML models to enhance API performance and automatically correct errors by redirecting software flow to alternative trails. Principal uses comprise maintaining software usability and reliability in cloud-based solutions. The system comprises a hardware processor and a computer-readable medium storing instructions for identifying software function flows, generating a trail passage matrix, and redirecting flow based on detected errors. This approach offers a nearly bug-free software experience tailored to customer-specific needs.

US20260310292.title: DEEP LEARNING ASSISTED TEXTILE SENSOR MATRIX FOR CO-ADAPTIVE HUMAN-ROBOT COLLABORATION
US20260310292.abstract: [0000]    A textile-based sensing system is disclosed that includes a textile substrate formed from interlaced semiconducting textile fibers and metal fibers. Intersections between the semiconducting textile fibers and the metal fibers define a plurality of non-ohmic junctions configured to generate electrical signals in response to mechanical stimuli applied to the textile substrate. The plurality of non-ohmic junctions collectively form a distributed textile sensor matrix. One or more processing devices receive electrical signals generated by the textile sensor matrix and process the signals using a trained model configured to compensate for variability arising from non-conformal contact between the textile substrate and a user. Based on analysis of spatiotemporal patterns in the electrical signals, the trained model classifies at least one of a user interaction or an object interaction. The classification is used to interface with an electromechanical system to cause interaction-dependent control.

WO2026212615.title: PROCÉDÉS ET APPAREIL D'ALIGNEMENT ET DE RECONSTRUCTION D'IMAGE INTERMODAUX BASÉS SUR L'APPRENTISSAGE PROFOND
WO2026212615.abstract: Systems and methods for deep-learning based inter-modal registration processes and image reconstruction are disclosed. For example, an image reconstruction system receives a positron emission tomography (PET) image and a co-modality image from an image scanning system. The system applies a trained machine learning process to the PET image and the co-modality image to generate transformation data characterizing an alignment between the PET image and the co-modality image, and generates a transformed image by transforming the co-modality image based on the transformation data. Further, the system applies a registration process to the transformed image and the PET image to generate a registered image that is registered to the PET image. The system can reconstruct a final image based on the registered image and the PET image.

WO2026213039.abstract: The techniques described herein relate to deep learning modules and methods for high-speed, high-accuracy processing of symbols of various types. The techniques can include accessing an image of a symbol comprising information, inputting the image of the symbol into a deep learning module, and generating, with the deep learning module, predicted information based on the image of the symbol. The predicted information can include codewords, which correspond to the information contained in the symbol. The codewords can be further processed for generating the information. Such techniques can enable fast and accurate processing of symbols of various types and multiple symbols simultaneously.

US20260311349.title: METHODS AND APPARATUS FOR DEEP LEARNING BASED INTER-MODAL IMAGE REGISTRATION AND RECONSTRUCTION
US20260311349.abstract: Systems and methods for deep-learning based inter-modal registration processes and image reconstruction are disclosed. For example, an image reconstruction system receives a positron emission tomography (PET) image and a co-modality image from an image scanning system. The system applies a trained machine learning process to the PET image and the co-modality image to generate transformation data characterizing an alignment between the PET image and the co-modality image, and generates a transformed image by transforming the co-modality image based on the transformation data. If the transformed image is not sufficiently aligned with the PET image, the system applies the trained machine learning process to the PET image and the transformed image to generate additional transformation data characterizing an alignment between the PET image and the transformed image. This iterative process continues until the transformed image is registered to the PET image.

US20260311879.title: NEUROLOGICAL DISORDER CLASSIFICATION USING LOG-REGULARIZED LAPLACIAN SPARSE FUNCTIONAL CONNECTIVITY AND ENSEMBLE GRAPH-BASED DEEP LEARNING
US20260311879.abstract: [0000]    A computer-implemented method, system, and computer program product for classifying a neurological disorder. Resting-state functional magnetic resonance imaging (rs-fMRI) data and phenotypic data associated with a subject are received. A sparse functional connectivity (FC) matrix is then estimated from the rs-fMRI data by minimizing an objective function comprising a Laplacian graph trace term and a log-regularized weight term. The discriminative brain connectivity features are then generated from the sparse FC matrix using an Adaptive-Hierarchical Graph Convolutional Network (AH-GCN). Discriminative brain connectivity features refer to a set of high-level, reduced-dimensional latent representations that capture the most topologically significant functional patterns in the subject's brain. Phenotypic data may then be processed through a plurality of machine learning classifiers to generate phenotypic probability scores. Furthermore, the discriminative brain connectivity features and the phenotypic probability scores are synthesized via a stacking meta-classifier to generate a classification for the neurological disorder.

US20260307677.title: SYSTEM FOR DETECTING 3D OBJECT AND CORRECTING HEADING ANGLE BASED ON AI DEEP LEARNING FOR AUTONOMOUS DRIVING AND METHOD THEREOF
US20260307677.abstract: [0000]    In a system and method for recognizing an object through an AI module and an autonomous driving sensor and correcting a heading angle, the system includes a processor including an object recognition module, as part of the AI module, that recognizes an object existing in a surrounding environment from data input from the autonomous driving sensor, and a memory that stores point cloud data, wherein the AI module executes determining whether to correct the heading angle based on estimation of a kernel density, and correcting the heading angle for a P-Box predicted by the autonomous driving sensor and the AI module when it is determined that correction is necessary as a result of determining whether to correct the heading angle.

EP4819158.title: VERFAHREN UND SYSTEME UNTER VERWENDUNG VON TIEFENLERNEN ZUR IDENTIFIZIERUNG VON LUNGENVENENISOLIERUNGSUNANTWORTEN
EP4819158.abstract: [0001]    A system trains a set of machine-learning models to predict which atrial fibrillation patients would respond to which treatments using ablation lines. The models identify an ablation line treatment for a patient based on atrial fibrillation-related features associated with the patient. The models estimate reconnection probabilities for ablation sites associated with at least one ablation line treatment. The models identify patient atrial fibrillation predictors associated with the patient, based on demographics and heart component dimension parameters associated with the patient, and use the at least one ablation line treatment, reconnection probabilities, patient atrial fibrillation predictors, and patient demographics to predict whether the patient would not respond to pulmonary vein isolation only treatment. In response to a prediction that the patient would not respond to pulmonary vein isolation only treatment, the system enables a healthcare provider to provide the at least one ablation line treatment for the patient.

WO2026207886.title: PROCÉDÉ DE SEGMENTATION D'IMAGE CELLULAIRE BASÉ SUR UN APPRENTISSAGE PROFOND, SYSTÈME, SUPPORT DE STOCKAGE ET TERMINAL
WO2026207886.abstract: The present invention belongs to the field of biological information. Disclosed are a deep learning-based cell image segmentation method, a system, a storage medium and a terminal. The cell image segmentation method comprises the steps: acquiring a bright-field microscopy image of a cell to be segmented; and inputting the bright-field microscopy image into a trained cell image segmentation model for segmenting same, so as to output a cell segmentation image, the cell image segmentation model comprising an encoder and a decoder, the encoder being an improved pre-activated residual network and used for extracting features from the input bright-field microscopy image and inputting same into the decoder, the decoder consisting of a Pixel branch sub-network and a HoVer branch sub-network, the Pixel branch sub-network being used for determining whether each pixel of the input bright-field microscopy image belongs to a cell region or background and outputting a preliminary segmentation image, the HoVer branch sub-network being used for calculating the horizontal offset and the vertical offset of each pixel relative to a cell centroid and outputting a precise segmentation image, and the preliminary segmentation image and the precise segmentation image being fused such that the cell segmentation image is generated. The present invention can precisely segment cells of different morphologies, different contrasts, and different degrees of overlapping, thereby improving the robustness and accuracy of cell detection.

US20260301466.title: DEEP-LEARNING BASED HUMAN ACTIVITY RECOGNITION SYSTEM AND METHOD THEREOF
US20260301466.abstract: [0000]    The present invention discloses a method of multifaceted deep learning system (101) comprising Enhanced Human Activity Recognition using CNN and Bi-LSTM. The method according to the present invention comprises various stages: Stage I: Data Preprocessing; Stage II: Convolutional Layers (Spatial Feature Extraction); Stage III: LSTM Module (120) (Temporal Modeling); Stage IV: Skip Connections. During Data proessing stage, Video data from the datasets is collected and Videos are resized to a consistent resolution, to ensure uniformity. Temporal segmentation is performed to divide videos into sequences of a fixed length to create input samples. During Convolutional Layers stage, Convolutional layers are applied to the video frames to extract spatial features. During Temporal Modeling stage, Bi-LSTM module (120) is used for modeling temporal dependencies in the video sequences. During Skip Connections stage, Skip connections are added between plurality of convolutional modules to improve gradient flow and training stability.

US20260303428.title: DEEP LEARNING-AIDED PHASE NOISE CANCELLATION FOR DISCRETE FOURIER TRANSFORM–SPREAD ORTHOGONAL FREQUENCY DIVISION MULTIPLEXING
US20260303428.abstract: [0000]    Methods and apparatus for estimating phase noise (PN) in communication systems employing orthogonal frequency division multiplexing (OFDM) and discrete Fourier transform spreading (DFT-s). Implementations can facilitate reductions in communication overhead and improved estimations of PN. To estimate PN in a received signal, a search space of candidate PN values is constructed by a neural network based on interpolations obtained from phase-tracking pilot signals. A path metric is calculated for each candidate value to determine its likelihood, and another neural network is used weigh the candidate values and determine an optimal PN estimate within the search space for the signal. The neural networks are trained by supervised and communication-aware training.

US20260298640.title: MAP MATCHING ON LOW SAMPLING RATE TRAJECTORIES THROUGH DEEP INVERSE REINFORCEMENT LEARNING AND MULTI-INTENTION MODELING
US20260298640.abstract: Systems and methods of map matching are provided that can model driving behavior by learning reward functions that characterize the driving preferences of different driver groups from historical trajectory data using multi-intention deep inverse reinforcement learning, or features thereof. MIDIRL can use historical trajectory data to infer the underlying reward functions, which may reflect different driving behavior. An IRL model may be used to observe the known driving trajectories and learn the reward structures that would have led to the known driving paths. MIDIRL can integrate IRL into the map matching process and may use a Q-learning algorithm to search for the best-connected path between consecutive GPS points received as new location data. The algorithm can maximize the cumulative reward by considering both the reward values and the travel time differences and determine the driving path on a road network between at least two location data points.

US20260301867.abstract: Methods for genome-wide DNA methylation analysis at single-cell resolution are provided. In some forms, biological samples to be analyzed contain multiple cell types, and individual cells are present in multiple regulatory states. The methods obtain single-cell epigenetic information including repetitive DNA elements, and provide full sets of 46 chromosomes corresponding to specific cell regulatory states. The methods include grouping assembly performed by alignment of long DNA sequences containing linearly contiguous DNA methylation information for entire chromosomes, guided by DNA methylation sequence information present in single-cell Methyl-seq data. Grouping assembly generates a multiplicity of distinct full sets of chromosome complements. The methods generate improved single-cell Methyl-seq data sets, augmented by additional information that accurately maps the DNA methylation states of all repetitive elements. The methods include data-acquisition and AI-based transformation of the acquired data.

EP4815393.title: AUF TIEFENLERNEN BASIERENDE TETHERING-ERKENNUNG
EP4815393.abstract: [0001]    Packets are captured that are associated with a communications flow in a communications network. An image generated by converting bits of the captured packets to pixel data. The image is input to a machine learning model that is trained to identify an operating system or operating system version based on image data. Identities of operating systems or operating system versions of source devices of the packets are received. Based on the identities, it is determined whether the packets are associated with at least two different operating systems or operating system versions. This indicates the use of device tethering in the communications flow.

US20260311515.title: FACE FORGERY DETECTION METHOD AND SYSTEM BASED ON GRAPH CONVOLUTIONAL NEURAL NETWORK
US20260311515.abstract: [0000]    The present application proposes a face forgery detection method based on a graph convolutional neural network, which includes: obtaining a to-be-detected face video; inputting the to-be-detected face video into a trained detection model to obtain a judgment result on whether the video is forged; wherein the detection model includes: an encoder, for generating features of each frame of the to-be-detected face video; a spatiotemporal composite graph construction module, for constructing a spatiotemporal composite graph composed of the spatial graph and the temporal graph based on the features of each frame of the input video; a spatiotemporal composite graph convolution module, for performing feature learning based on the spatiotemporal composite graph to obtain classification features; and a classifier, for predicting an authenticity result of the to-be-detected face video based on the classification features.

US20260310955.title: MISSION PREDICTION SYSTEM FOR SIMULTANEOUS MISSION SUCCESS AND ENEMY INTENT PREDICTION USING GRAPH NEURAL NETWORKS
US20260310955.abstract: The mission prediction system models a wargaming scenario as a graph. Once the GNN graph is defined, multiple sets of AIGC data is used to train the GNN graph. The trained GNN graph can then be used to perform inference on novel wargaming scenarios to simultaneously predict mission success and enemy intent in real-time, even if the novel wargaming scenarios involve a much greater number of assets than were used in the AIGC data. A viewer can be used to review the predictions and to analyze the novel wargaming scenario at different timesteps.

US20260310967.title: METHOD AND SYSTEM FOR PREDICTING GENERATED POWER OF NEW ENERGY STATION BASED ON RECURRENT GRAPH NEURAL NETWORK
US20260310967.abstract: [0000]    Provided are a method and system for predicting the generated power of the new energy station based on the recurrent graph neural network. The method includes the following: A graph neural network model is pre-constructed, where the graph neural network model includes a graph neural network layer, a recurrent neural network layer, and a first full-connection layer; the historical weather forecast data of a target station, the actual power data of the target station, the historical weather forecast data of a source domain station, and the actual power data of the source domain station are acquired, and the graph neural network model is trained based on the historical weather forecast data of the source domain station and the actual power data of the source domain station to obtain a trained graph neural network model.

US20260301174.title: GRAPH NEURAL NETWORKS
US20260301174.abstract: A method comprising: generating subgraphs graph based on classification scores corresponding to nodes and obtained by inputting input graph into a graph neural network, GNN, wherein each node in each input graph comprises a plurality of values corresponding respectively to a plurality of features; determining statistical measures of each feature's values in the subgraphs to generate statistical measures for each subgraph, and obtaining for each subgraph classification probabilities corresponding respectively to a plurality of classes; performing k-means clustering on the subgraphs based on the statistical measures to generate a plurality of clusters of subgraphs; generating, for each cluster of subgraphs, a set of surrogate models to approximate the classification probabilities, respectively, of the subgraphs in the cluster, in terms of the statistical measures; and determining, based on the surrogate models of each set of surrogate models, feature importance scores.

DE102025108995.title: Verfahren zur Ermittlung von Informationen über Aktivitätszustände von Personen aus Radar-Rohdaten unter Verwendung eines Graph Neural Networks
DE102025108995.abstract: Es werden ein Verfahren zur Ermittlung von Informationen über Aktivitäten wenigstens eines Objekts (20), insbesondere wenigstens eines Verkehrsteilnehmers, in einem Überwachungsbereich wenigstens eines Radarsystems, insbesondere wenigstens eines Fahrzeug-Radarsystems, aus mit dem wenigstens einen Radarsystem (14) ermittelten Radar-Rohdaten, ein Radarsystem, ein Fahrerassistenzsystem, ein Fahrzeug und ein Algorithmus beschrieben. Bei dem Verfahren wird auf Basis wenigstens eines Teils der Radar-Rohdaten wenigstens ein Graph (72) ermittelt. Der wenigstens eine Graph (72) wird wenigstens einem Graph Neural Network (GAT) zugeführt. Die Information über die Aktivität des wenigstens einen Objekts (20) wird ausgegeben. US12732342.title: Hardware-accelerated execution of large language models over fully homomorphic encryption
US12732342.abstract: [0000]    A system and method for hardware-accelerated execution of a multi-token large language model (LLM) over fully homomorphic encryption (FHE) are presented. The method includes generating a plurality of tokens by homomorphic evaluation of a previous transformer cycle of the multi-token LLM; representing the plurality of tokens using one or more FHE ciphertext vectors; executing homomorphic transformer-layer operations on at least one of the one or more FHE ciphertext vectors using one or more layer processor devices; and performing ciphertext bootstrapping on at least another of the FHE ciphertext vectors using one or more bootstrap processor devices to refresh ciphertext noise and restore computational capacity, wherein the executing and performing steps are applied to different FHE ciphertext vectors.

US12695855.title: Hardware-accelerated multiscopic image generation
US12695855.abstract: A hardware apparatus receives a first image and a second image for a first eye and a second eye of at least one user, and metadata indicating, relative locations of light-emitting cells that can be employed to emit light toward the first eye and the second eye with respect to multiscopic cells in a multiscopic display. The hardware apparatus operates in a streaming manner to: determine, based on the metadata and calibration parameters specific to the multiscopic display, which light-emitting cells are to be employed to emit light toward the first eye and which light-emitting cells are to be employed to emit light toward the second eye; obtain emission values for the determined light-emitting cells based on the first image and the second image; and outputs the output image comprising emission values for the light-emitting cells.

US20260187425.title: WEIGHTED PATH SEARCH ACCELERATED BY SPIKING NEUROMORPHIC HARDWARE
US20260187425.abstract: [0000]    Nodes in a graph may be encoded in neurons of a neural network. Forward and backward spiking phases may be conducted to find shortest path. During the forward spiking phase, each neuron may update its state after determining that a spike it has received from a spiking neuron in the last time step has a value smaller than its current state value. The spike may include an edge weight and a state of the spiking neuron. During the backward spiking phase, each neuron may update its other state based on a spike from a neighboring neuron in a time step and an index of the current time step. The neuron may send its identifier (ID) to a host based on its states. The host may identify the shortest path from the source node to the target node based on neuron IDs it receives.

EP4769201.title: BESCHLEUNIGTER ABDECKUNGSABSCHLUSS IN HARDWARE-DESIGNS UNTER VERWENDUNG HIERARCHISCHER PRÜFSTÄNDE
EP4769201.abstract: Improved hardware design testing techniques qualify a current design by integrating select tests completed on prior design iterations. A product design may be divided into design unit subcomponents, and multiple test benches may individually be configured to test different groups of subcomponents. The test benches may be run on a series of iterations of an evolving product design. Qualification of a most recent current iteration of the product design can be simplified by incorporating some test results from tests performed on prior iteration checkpoints of the design into the qualification of the current design by first combining test results across time for each test bench, and then combining test results across the set of test benches.

CN122131979.abstract: The invention relates to the cross technical field of SSD (Solid State Disk) storage technology and retrieval enhancement generation technology, in particular to a retrieval enhancement generation system-oriented hardware acceleration embedding and vector retrieval integrated SSD storage device, which comprises an interface module, a hardware embedding module, a vector storage module, a hardware retrieval module, a control module and an NAND flash memory storage module, the interface module, the hardware-based Embedding module, the vector storage module, the hardware-based retrieval module, the control module and the NAND flash memory storage module are coupled and connected through an internal bus of the host, and the interface module adopts a PCIe5.0 interface and is used for performing high-speed data interaction with the host, receiving a preprocessed text data block and a user query text sent by the host and sending the preprocessed text data block and the user query text to the host; and feeding back the retrieved candidate text data or the storage address thereof to the host. US20260122254.title: HARDWARE-ACCELERATED INTRA FRAME ENCODING
US20260122254.abstract: Example systems, apparatus, articles of manufacture, and methods to implement hardware-accelerated intra frame encoding are disclosed. Example hardware-accelerated intra frame video encoders disclosed herein are VC3 compliant. Some example video encoders disclosed herein quantize alternating current (AC) coefficients of a macroblock of an input image frame using a small set of anchor quantization scale factors (QSFs), and interpolate between the resulting bit counts for the first anchor QSFs to determine an estimated QSF meets a target bit budget. Some example video encoders disclosed herein perform bit coding with a round-robin packing strategy that distributes the packing of encoded symbols among macroblocks and discards excess symbols to avoid exceeding the specified frame size. Some example video encoders disclosed herein are configurable via control circuitry and/or a driver that selects target bit budgets, anchor QSFs, encoding modes, etc., thereby enabling single or multi pass operation and adjustable performance versus quality trade-offs.

CN121940330.title: Hardware accelerated policy-based routing (PBR) over service function chain (SFC)
CN121940330.abstract: The invention relates to hardware accelerated policy-based routing (PBR) through service function chains (SFC). Techniques are described for creating optimized and accelerated network pipelines using a network pipeline abstraction layer (NPAL) for policy-based routing (PBR) over a service function chain (SFC). The DPU includes an acceleration hardware engine for providing a single acceleration data plane. The processing device may generate a first virtual bridge for control by a first network service hosted on the DPU and having a set of one or more network rules and a second virtual bridge; and the second virtual bridge has a policy-based routing policy (PBR policy). The processing device may add a virtual port between the first virtual bridge and the second virtual bridge. An acceleration hardware engine in a single acceleration data plane may route network traffic data using a PBR policy and process the network traffic data using a set of one or more network rules.

US12574252.title: METHOD AND HARDWARE FOR ACCELERATED TEST-DATA AUTHENTICATION
US12574252.abstract: An integrated circuit (IC) is disclosed. In one embodiment, the IC comprises a memory and at least one processing core coupled to the memory. In one embodiment, the operations the at least one processing core operatively coupled to the memory perform comprise storing final hashes of each block chain authentication (BCA) section of an in-system test (IST) image in a write-protected portion of the memory; receiving at least one Public Key Authentication (PKA) signature; authenticating the at least one PKA signature using public key cryptography (PKC) algorithm; once the PKA signature is authenticated, using the final hash for each BCA section to authenticate a portion of the IST image associated with each BCA section using a hash engine of the at least one processing core skipping any PKA signature checks for any of the final hashes; and testing portions of the IC with the authenticated IST image portion.

US20250363715.title: Path tracking for hardware-accelerated ray transforms
US20250363715.abstract: [0000]    Techniques are disclosed relating to ray tracing, particularly for path tracking through a bounding volume hierarchy, according to some embodiments. In some embodiments, ray intersection accelerator circuitry traverses a bounding volume hierarchy that includes transform nodes at multiple levels. Ray transform accelerator circuitry may transform ray information based on reaching a given transform node during the traversal. Path tracking hardware may determine a list of pointers to transform nodes in a traversal path taken to reach a first primitive. This may include utilizing at least two buffer circuits to store pointers for a candidate list and a committed list, storing candidate trail information that indicates, for a given position in the candidate list, which buffer stores a corresponding pointer, and storing committed trail information that indicates, for a given position in the committed list, which buffer stores a corresponding pointer.

US20250342638.title: FRAMEWORKS FOR IMPLEMENTING STREAMABLE AND HARDWARE ACCELERATED NEURAL 3D VOLUMES

Another embodiment is directed towards a computer-method for generating compressed video content. Yet another embodiment is directed towards a computer-implemented method for training generative artificial intelligence (AI) models.

US20250343947.title: FRAMEWORKS FOR IMPLEMENTING STREAMABLE AND HARDWARE ACCELERATED NEURAL 3D VOLUMES
US20250343947.abstract: [0000]    At least one embodiment is directed towards a computer-implemented method for generating compressed video content. The computer-implemented method includes the steps of receiving a plurality of triplanes associated with video content; extracting channel range values from each triplane included in the plurality of triplanes; normalizing the plurality of triplanes based on the channel range values to generate a plurality of normalized triplanes; storing the channel range values with the plurality of normalized triplanes; generating a plurality of tiled triplanes based on the plurality of normalized triplanes; compressing the plurality of tiled triplanes to generate compressed video content; and transmitting the compressed video content to an endpoint device. Another embodiment is directed towards a computer-method for rendering video content. Yet another embodiment is directed towards a computer-implemented method for training generative artificial intelligence (AI) models.

US20250342400.title: FRAMEWORKS FOR IMPLEMENTING STREAMABLE AND HARDWARE ACCELERATED NEURAL 3D VOLUMES
US20250342400.abstract: [0000]    At least one embodiment is directed towards a computer-implemented method for training generative artificial intelligence (AI) models. The computer-implemented method includes the steps of receiving a plurality of training images; rendering, via a generative AI model, a plurality of synthetic images based on the plurality of training images; generating triplane loss metrics for the plurality of synthetic images by comparing the plurality of synthetic images against the plurality of training images; generating total variation (TV) loss metrics based on the triplane loss metrics; generating triplane compression loss metrics based on the triplane loss metrics; generating total loss metrics based on the TV loss metrics and the triplane compression loss metrics; and performing at least one backpropagation operation based on the total loss metrics to update weights associated with the generative AI model to generate an updated generative AI model.

US20250337684.title: Hardware-accelerated flexible steering rules over service function chaining (SFC)
US20250337684.abstract: [0000]    Technologies for configuring flexible hardware-accelerated rules in a Service Function Chaining (SFC) architecture are described. A DPU includes an acceleration hardware engine to provide a single accelerated data plane, and a processing device that generates a first virtual bridge and a second virtual bridge. The first virtual bridge is controlled by a first network service hosted on the DPU and has a first set of one or more network rules. The second virtual bridge has a second set of one or more user-defined network rules. The processing device generates a combined set of network rules based on the first set of one or more network rules and the second set of one or more user-defined network rules. The acceleration hardware engine processes network traffic data in the single accelerated data plane using the combined set of network rules.

US20260289411.title: AUTOMATED VALUATION MODEL (AVM) AND TECHNIQUES FOR REDUCING LEAKAGE IN MACHINE LEARNING DATASETS
US20260289411.abstract: System, apparatus and method may control receiving time-indexed data comprising values of a plurality of features; generating derived features based on temporal changes of at least one of the plurality of features, the derived features including at least a first derivative of a first value; temporally aligning the plurality of features and the derived features to a reference date such that only data available prior to the reference date is used for training a machine learning model; training a machine learning model on the temporally aligned features and the derived features to predict a forward-looking value; and outputting the forward-looking value.

US12725453.title: Multi-domain ground-truth data structurization with automated contextual enrichment and valuation
US12725453.abstract: [0000]    Apparatus and related methods may relate to transforming heterogeneous real-world data into standardized data assets, such as for ingestion by AI models. In an illustrative example, a method may include generating, for standardized data assets, a dataset-quality score. The method may, for example, include storing each standardized data asset together with its dataset-quality score in a distributed database. The method may, for example, include performing automated data completeness verification on standardized data assets stored in the distributed database. The method may include, for example, generating a privacy-preserving training view in response to a request received from an external artificial-intelligence system. The privacy-preserving training view may, for example, include from the first data structure only data that satisfies the stored output generation rules. The second data structure may, for example, be retained in the distributed database. An auditable compliance chain associated with the unique identifier may, for example, be preserved.

US20260245124.title: IMPROVEMENTS TO MACHINE LEARNING SYSTEMS AND REAL ESTATE VALUATION USING CROWDSOURCED ESTIMATES WITH PROPERTY-DEPENDENT USER WEIGHTING AND AUTOMATED ATTRIBUTE DISCOVERY
US20260245124.abstract: A machine learning system and method for estimating real estate property sales prices by combining property attributes, contextual attributes, and crowdsourced user estimates in a closed-loop learning system. The system learns numeric representations for properties and users, and employs a modified weighting mechanism that incorporates property information into the value computation, enabling property-specific adjustment of user estimates based on learned user biases. Unlike standard weighting mechanisms that compute values solely from input source representations, the modified mechanism computes values from a combination of user representations, user price estimates, and property representations, enabling context-dependent corrections through a multi-layer transformation. A related method discovers new property attributes by identifying properties with similar attributes but different prices, collecting free-form natural-language feedback, clustering similar feedback using semantic analysis, and validating candidate attributes through quantitative backtesting.

US20260236971.title: AUTOMATED SEARCH, CATEGORIZATION, AND VALUATION OF ITEMS EXTRACTED FROM VIDEO OR IMAGE
US20260236971.abstract: Novel tools and techniques are provided for implementing automated search, categorization, and valuation of items extracted from video or image. In examples, a computing system may autonomously identify an object from an area in an image, using image recognition, and may autonomously query one or more databases and/or one or more search engines for objects equivalent to the identified object and corresponding prices. The computing system may receive results from the one or more databases and/or the one or more search engines, the results including an equivalent object(s) and a price(s) associated with each equivalent object. The computing system may autonomously perform a valuation of the identified object, based on the price(s) associated with each equivalent object, may autonomously generate a report based on the valuation, and may present the report to a user or user device.

KR20260072173.title: Automated Valuation Method for Studio Apartments Using Machine Learning Techniques
KR20260072173.abstract: [0001a]    [본 발명은 준주택인 오피스텔의 객관적이고 체계적인 가치 산정을 위해 머신러닝 기법을 적용하여 적정가를 자동으로 예측하는 방법, 해당 호실의 속성정보를 가지고 비교그룹 중 선정된 머신러닝 모델을 학습시켜 개별 매물의 적정 가격을 예측하는 방법에 관한 것이다.]

US20250191046.title: Automated recognition, registration, and tracking of user items and intelligent machine valuation of user items based on peer interests in an augmented-reality or mixed-reality environment
US20250191046.abstract: [0000]    A novel electronic system provides automated recognition, registration, and location tracking of physical, holographic, and/or virtual user items that can be visualized in a computer graphics-infused augmented-reality or mixed-reality environment with an electronic visualization device. The novel electronic system is also capable of executing intelligent machine valuation of user items and reflecting dynamic changes in valuation based on peer interests within the augmented-realty or mixed-reality environment. Each user item identified in the user's visual perspective through the electronic visualization device connected to the novel electronic system undergoes object extractions, class categorizations, and image segmentations by the novel electronic system to determine whether a particular item is substantive and worthy of location tracking, based on the item owner's preferences. The item is paired with related metadata and stored in a system database, and later retrieved by a search command in the augmented-reality or mixed-reality environment to display its known location.

US20250148386.title: AUTOMATED INCENTIVIZER FOR CONTACT CENTER AGENTS USING VARIABLE POINTS VALUATION
US20250148386.abstract: [0000]    A method for incentivizing agents with scheduling perks that includes: receiving a workload forecast; receiving a staffing plan; receiving data describing a service level target; receiving data describing the scheduling perks; performing a valuation routine for determining a value of points in relation to trading for the scheduling perks during; and performing an offer routine offering the scheduling perks to the current agents per the determined value of the points. The valuation routine includes: measuring current shift performance data; providing the staffing plan, the workload forecast, and the current shift performance data as inputs to a predictive model and calculating therewith an actual forecasted target adherence for the service level target; comparing the actual forecasted target adherence against an acceptable threshold to determine a valuation parameter; and valuing the points according to a direct relationship with the valuation parameter.

US20240054514.title: AUTOMATED VALUATION OF AN EXHIBITION BOOTH
US20240054514.abstract: [0000]    Described are systems and methods of an exhibition management system that automatically creates, maintains, valuates and re-valuates a booth in a venue. Automated valuation and re-valuation is a process of determining an optimal value for the booth. Based on various factors and subsystems, the optimal value is determined. The booth value thus determined is projected to the organizers, prospective exhibitors for sale. Automating such a system increases the booth value, brings in more prospective exhibitors and facilitates (reduces) the manual process carried out by the organizers of such an exhibition.

WO2024042341.title: PROCÉDÉ ET SYSTÈME D'ÉVALUATION AUTOMATISÉE DE DONNÉES BIOLOGIQUES
WO2024042341.abstract: The invention relates to a method for the automated evaluation of biological data and a system for implementing the same. Based on a data set produced after bioinformatics analysis of databases and a query in natural language, artificial intelligence networks produce a limited and sorted subset of results that satisfy the query and which are used to automatically generate a natural language report. There are also additional artificial intelligence networks to examine a number of parameters of the results and the accuracy of the generated natural language report.
claims:
1. CLAIMS
1. A method for the automated valuation of biological data in three stages, where in the first stage a data set produced after bioinformatic analysis of databases is taken as input and includes at least the taxonomic code for searching in the databases and a natural language query, so as to produce as output a limited set of data that includes the specific taxonomic code and where based on the user query in natural language, using a first set of transformed trained models, calculation of a vector and comparison between the vectors is performed by calculating their distance so that a list is formed showing each publication and the semantic search score in descending order, in the second stage the sorted and limited data set is fed to an artificial intelligence network based on recurrent neural network methods to examine a series of parameters and forward to the next layer of only the results that exceed a certain, predefined threshold in parameter values, in the third stage the sorted and limited data set that exceeded the threshold in parameter values is used as input to a third artificial intelligence network, where using a third set of trained transforms models, a report is produced in natural language format.
2. A method for the automated valuation of biological data, according to claim 1 , wherein the report in natural language format resulting from the third stage is evaluated by evaluation models on a series of data so that if the final accuracy result exceeds a certain, predetermined threshold, the report is accepted and forwarded to the user.
3. A system for the automated valuation of biological data, consisting of a first artificial intelligence network that uses a first set of transformer trained models to semantically analyze and classify a set of scientific data based on a user's query in natural language and produces a list including every related publication and the semantic search score in descending order, a second artificial intelligence network, which uses recurrent neural network methods, examines the list of the sorted and limited dataset for a set of parameters and forwards to the next layer only the results that pass a specific, predefined threshold in parameter values, and a third artificial intelligence network, that uses a second set of transformer trained models, which takes as input the list of the relevant publications that exceeded the threshold in parameter values and produces as output the final report in natural language form.
4. The system for the automated valuation of biological data according to claim 3, wherein a fourth artificial intelligence network, using evaluation models, evaluates a series of data in the final report in natural language format and if the final accuracy result exceeds a certain, predetermined threshold, the final report is accepted.

US2022292550.title: Apparatuses, Systems, and Methods for Providing an Automated Valuation Model for Commercial Real Estate
US2022292550.abstract: Apparatuses, systems, and methods provide an Automated Valuation Model (AVM). The AVM includes one or more operations including providing a portal coupleable to a network interface, obtaining a plurality of valuations associated with a subject property via the portal, receiving at least one weighting factor associated with one or more of the plurality of valuations from a user via the portal, applying the least one weighting factor to each of the plurality of valuations, determining a combined value estimate using the weighted plurality of valuations, generating one or more sets of property information responsive to the combined value estimate, and transmitting the generated one or more sets of property information via the portal.

US2022188950.title: SYSTEM AND METHOD OF SEMI-AUTOMATED DETERMINATION OF A VALUATION OF A PATENT APPLICATION OF AN ENTITY
US2022188950.abstract: Disclosed is a method for semi-automated determination of a valuation of a patent application of an entity using machine learning based on a dynamic representation of the patent application in at least one dimension, characterized in that the method comprises: generating a database that comprises at least one layer of information that is selected from at least one of megatrends, indicators, ontology, codes, devices or key figures associated at least one of Intellectual property information, market information, finance information, company information, people information, time information and geographic information that are obtained using a communication protocol information exchange over a distributed network, demographic changes, societal disparities, differentiated lifeworlds, digital transformation, biotechnical transformation, volatile economy, business ecosystems, anthropogenic environmental damage, changed work environments, new political world order, global power shifts, or urbanisation; generating a representation of the patent application in at least one dimension based on the at least one layer of information; training a machine learning model by comparing the at least one layer of the information for the patent application with corresponding layer of information for comparable patents; processing a user input from a user interaction with the at least one dimensional representation of the patent application; providing the user input as training data to refine the machine learning model; and dynamically updating a valuation of the patent application by applying a machine learning algorithm to the machine learning model.

US2022084079.title: Automated valuation model using a siamese network
US2022084079.abstract: [0001]    Systems and methods are disclosed for automatically determining property value, the systems and methods perform operations comprising: receiving, by a server, subject real-estate property listing information associated with a subject real-estate property; identifying a plurality of comparable real-estate property listings based on attributes of the subject real-estate property listing information; processing the subject real-estate property listing information together with the plurality of comparable real-estate property listings using a trained machine learning technique to predict a value for the subject real-estate property, the trained machine learning technique being trained to jointly establish a relationship between weights assigned to a set of training comparable real-estate property listings and value adjustments of the set of training comparable real-estate property listings and a value of a real-estate property of interest; and performing an action with respect to the subject real-estate property based on the predicted value of the subject real-estate property.

US2021407020.title: SYSTEM AND METHOD FOR THE SYSTEMATIC ANALYSIS OF ENERGY AND WATER BILLING DATA AND THE AUTOMATED FILTERING, DIAGNOSIS, AND VALUATION OF ANOMALIES IN THE DATA
US2021407020.abstract: [0001]    A computer implemented system and method for eliminating hidden operating and financial waste in energy and water consumption and costs with maximum efficiency and economy by systematically analyzing energy and water billing data from almost any source and automatically filtering, diagnosing, and valuating the anomalies in the data.

US2021103990.title: AUTOMATED REAL TIME MORTGAGE SERVICING AND WHOLE LOAN VALUATION
US2021103990.abstract: A system is disclosed. The system has a mortgage servicing and loan valuation module, comprising computer-executable code stored in non-volatile memory, a processor, and a network component configured to communicate with the mortgage servicing and loan valuation module and the processor. The mortgage servicing and loan valuation module, the processor, and the network component are configured to receive a pricing file via the network component, provide a plurality of machine learning regression models, determine one or more of the plurality of machine learning regression models to apply to the pricing file, apply the determined one or more of the plurality of machine learning regression models to the pricing file, and transfer a priced portfolio to the network component.

EP4822751.title: FESTKÖRPERBATTERIE UND VERFAHREN ZUR HERSTELLUNG EINER FESTKÖRPERBATTERIE
EP4822751.abstract: A solid-state battery includes: a first electrode layer containing a first electrode active material; an electrolyte layer containing a solid electrolyte and disposed on the first electrode layer; and a second electrode layer containing a second electrode active material and disposed on the electrolyte layer. An Sdr of a surface of the first electrode layer in contact with the electrolyte layer is 9.2% or more.

1. A solid-state battery comprising: a first electrode layer containing a first electrode active material;
an electrolyte layer containing a solid electrolyte and disposed on the first electrode layer; and
a second electrode layer containing a second electrode active material and disposed on the electrolyte layer, wherein
an Sdr of a surface of the first electrode layer in contact with the electrolyte layer is 9.2% or more. 2. The solid-state battery according to claim 1, wherein the first electrode active material is a cathode active material, and the first electrode layer is a cathode layer disposed on a cathode current collector. 3. The solid-state battery according to claim 1, wherein no adhesive layer is provided between the first electrode layer and the electrolyte layer. 4. A method for manufacturing a solid-state battery, the method comprising: kneading materials other than a first electrode active material, and then adding the first electrode active material and further kneading the materials;

forming a second electrode layer containing a second electrode active material on the electrolyte layer, wherein
an Sdr of a surface of the first electrode layer in contact with the electrolyte layer is 9.2%. 5. The method according to claim 4, wherein, in the forming of the electrolyte layer, the electrolyte layer is transferred onto the first electrode layer. 6. The method according to claim 4, further comprising pressurizing the first electrode layer and the electrolyte layer in a laminating direction after the forming of the electrolyte layer.

EP4822490.title: KÜHLSYSTEM FÜR FESTKÖRPERANTRIEBE
EP4822490.abstract: [0001]    A cooling system (100) for a set of solid state drive (SSD) modules (200) includes a thermal mounting frame (110). The thermal mounting frame includes a thermal transfer plate (112), and a plurality of parallel fins (114) that project outward from a first side (116) of the thermal transfer plate along a length dimension (118). The first side of the thermal transfer plate in combination with each neighboring pair of fins (122) of the plurality of parallel fins defines a slot (124) that accommodates a corresponding SSD module (210) of the set of SSD modules. The thermal transfer plate includes a plurality of parallel spines (320) in which each spine projects into a core region (132) of a corresponding fin of the plurality of parallel fins along a base portion (310) of the length dimension of the fin. For each slot, each fin of the neighboring pair of fins that defines the slot includes an exterior thermal transfer layer (130).

EP4822990.title: ABSCHALTSTROMSTEUERUNG IN FESTKÖRPERSCHUTZSCHALTERN
EP4822990.abstract: The present technology relates to clamping breaking currents in a circuit breaker to protect solid-state switches of the circuit breaker during an overload event. In an embodiment, a circuit breaker includes processing circuitry and switching circuitry coupled to the processing circuitry. The switching circuitry includes a first switch coupled to an AC voltage supply, a second switch, and the processing circuitry, a second switch coupled to the first switch, a load, and the processing circuitry, a first current clamping circuit coupled to the AC voltage supply, the second switch, and the processing circuitry, and a second current clamping circuit coupled to the AC voltage supply the first switch, and the processing circuitry. The processing circuitry monitors current at the load and provides gating signals to the first and second switches and the first and second current clamping circuits to control current flow between the AC voltage supply and the load.

US12762024.title: Reducing cost of metadata storage in a solid state drive-based storage system
US12762024.abstract: A system can store a first copy of metadata of data of a log storage system on performance drives of the log storage system that satisfy a performance criterion, wherein the first copy of the metadata satisfies an in-place criterion. The system can store a second copy of the metadata in a redundant array of inexpensive drives configuration and in a log structure on capacity drives of the log storage system that satisfy a capacity criterion. The system can serve a request to access at least a part of the metadata from the first copy of the metadata on the performance drives. The system can restore a data loss of the first copy of the metadata with the capacity drives.

WO2026210713.title: BATTERIE À L'ÉTAT SOLIDE
WO2026210713.abstract: In the present invention, a battery cell (1) comprises: a positive electrode layer (30); a negative electrode layer (50); a solid electrolyte layer (40) that contains a solid electrolyte and that is interposed between the positive electrode layer (30) and the negative electrode layer (50); and a frame (60) that covers the outer circumferential surface (303) of the positive electrode layer (30) and that has electronically insulating properties. WO2026211015.abstract: The present disclosure addresses the problem of providing a solid-state battery that can ensure battery performance even if a solid electrolyte layer is configured to be thin. A solid-state battery according to one aspect for solving the above problem has a laminated structure in which a negative electrode layer, a solid electrolyte layer, and a positive electrode layer are laminated in this order. US20260312056.title: SOLID-STATE LITHIUM-SULFUR BATTERY
US20260312056.abstract: A solid-state lithium-sulfur battery includes a positive electrode current collector layer, a positive electrode active material layer, a solid electrolyte layer, and a negative electrode current collector layer in this order. The positive electrode active material layer contains a sulfur-based active material, a solid electrolyte, and a resin binder that binds them to each other, the resin binder is butadiene rubber not containing fluorine, and a content of the resin binder in the positive electrode active material layer is more than 0.0% by mass and 0.5% by mass or less.

WO2026212135.title: BATTERIE ENTIÈREMENT SOLIDE BIPOLAIRE
WO2026212135.abstract: The present invention relates to a bipolar all solid-state battery and, more specifically, comprises: a first unit cell; a second unit cell connected and stacked in series on the first unit cell; and a first conductive elastic pad between the first unit cell and the second unit cell, wherein each of the first and second unit cells includes an anode current collector, a coating layer, a solid electrolyte layer, a cathode active material layer and a cathode current collector that are sequentially stacked, and the first conductive elastic pad includes: a first elastic layer having a first upper surface, a first lower surface, a first side surface and a second side surface, the first and second side surfaces facing each other between the first upper surface and the first lower surface; and a first metal layer covering the first upper surface, the first lower surface and the first side surface but not the second side surface.

WO2026210735.abstract: Provided is an overheated state determination method for determining the overheated state of a solid-state battery. An overheated state determination method according to the present invention is for a battery cell (1) comprising: a positive electrode current collector (11) and a negative electrode current collector (12) made of materials such that a positive electrode and a negative electrode have different thermal conductivities; a positive electrode tab (31) electrically and thermally connected to the positive electrode current collector (12); and a negative electrode tab (32) electrically and thermally connected to the negative electrode current collector (12), the battery cell (1) also being provided with a solid electrolyte layer (14) as an electrolyte. In this method, two temperature measurement parts (41, 42) for measuring or estimating the respective temperatures of the positive electrode tab and the negative electrode tab are disposed on the positive electrode and negative electrode tabs (31, 32), respectively. When the temperature difference (ΔT ( = TH - TL)) between, from among the two temperature measurement parts (41, 42), the temperature (TH) of the electrode having the higher thermal conductivity and the temperature (TL) of the electrode having the lower thermal conductivity is equal to or less than a threshold value (Tth), the determination is made that the battery is in a non-overheated state, and when the temperature difference exceeds the threshold value (Tth), the determination is made that the battery is in an overheated state.

US20260308111.title: SOLID STATE SALIFICATION OF ORGANIC MOLECULES
US20260308111.abstract: [0000]    In accordance with the purpose(s) of the present disclosure, as embodied and broadly described herein, the disclosure, in one aspect, relates to methods for producing a salt of a solid organic compound. The method involves (a) combining in the solid state the solid organic compound comprising one or more protonatable groups and an acid composition, wherein the amount of acid in the acid composition is about stoichiometric or less than stoichiometric relative to the one or more protonatable groups of the solid organic compound to produce a precursor mixture; and mixing the precursor mixture by mechanochemical milling to produce the salt of the solid organic compound. CN122354158.title: Refrigerator car peak-valley electricity price cold storage and cold release method based on modular phase change cold storage
CN122354158.abstract: According to the refrigerator car peak-valley electricity price cold storage and cold release method based on modular phase change cold storage, through cooperation of valley electricity cold storage and the cold core module, the cold-chain logistics operation cost is remarkably reduced, and peak-valley electricity price arbitrage is achieved. The cold core module charges cold in a low ebb period, replaces or assists in mechanical refrigeration in a peak period, and can serve as a movable cold source to supplement cold for the refrigeration house, so that the cold energy utilization efficiency is improved. The system adopts a high-performance phase change material and an optimized heat exchange structure, so that the low-temperature stability in the transportation process is effectively guaranteed, and the risk of chain breakage is prevented. The cold core module supports flexible allocation between the refrigerator car and the refrigeration house, and dynamic allocation of the cooling capacity of storage and transportation scenes is achieved. The modular quick-assembly design facilitates quick replacement and maintenance under high-frequency transportation, and the temperature of the compartment is ensured to be constant in cooperation with an intelligent bimodal temperature control system. The material is good in cycling stability, long in service life and free of leakage risk. The whole scheme is outstanding in energy-saving effect, greatly reduces carbon emission, and has the advantages of economy, environmental protection and large-scale application.

CN122288773.title: Second-hand car entrance and exit price interval prediction method based on machine learning
CN122288773.abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of second-hand vehicle import and export price interval prediction, in particular to a machine learning-based second-hand vehicle import and export price interval prediction method, which comprises the following steps of: extracting customs declaration detection data to establish a sample library, comparing supply and demand of same-level alternative vehicle types to quantify market competition differences, and tracking multi-stage score fluctuation to generate a vehicle condition dynamic record. And associating the time interval with the features to construct a price learning sample, establishing feature and transaction price mapping to allocate weights, and further generating a center price and an offset range to determine a second-hand vehicle entrance and exit price upper and lower boundary prediction interval. According to the method, a sample library is constructed by associating customs declaration detection storage order information with identification codes, quantitative supply and demand are compared to establish a competition set, multi-stage scoring is tracked to evaluate vehicle condition fluctuation, declaration prices, circulation intervals, supply and demand and vehicle condition features are integrated to establish learning samples, and weights are distributed through feature mapping. And generating a center price and an offset range to determine a second-hand vehicle entrance and exit price prediction interval.
CN122288773.assignee: JILIN YUEXUAN AUTOMOTIVE TECH CO LTD

KR20260075482.title: AI Used car transaction brokerage computer system and method using artificial intelligence AI price tracking algorithm
KR20260075482.abstract: 본 발명에서는 적어도 하나의 하드웨어 프로세서와 중고자동차 거래 중개 관련 프로그램을 저장한 메모리를 포함하고, 상기 적어도 하나의 하드웨어 프로세서가 상기 메모리에 저장된 프로그램의 실행을 제어하는 컴퓨터로서, 판매자의 보유 중고자동차의 시세 정보와 관련하여 인공지능(AI) 가격추적수단의 기반으로 상기 중고자동차의 최적 가격정보 및 최적 판매시점 정보를 포함하는 가격추적산출데이터를 산출하고; 상기 가격추적산출데이터를 중고자동차의 시세와 관련된 배경지식으로 하여 결정한 보유 중고자동차의 희망 판매가격 및 판매시점 정보를 포함하는 중고자동차의 판매신청 정보를 상기 판매자로부터 제공받고; 상기 판매자의 중고자동차의 판매신청 정보를 기반으로 적어도 하나의 딜러가 제공하는 중고자동차의 구매 입찰서를 수신하여 상기 판매자에게 제공하고; 상기 판매자로부터 특정 구매 입찰서의 선택 정보를 수신하여 상기 특정 구매 입찰서를 제공한 딜러에게 상기 선택 정보를 전송하고; 상기 판매자와 딜러간의 상기 중고자동차 매매계약 체결정보를 수신하는 것을 특징으로 하는 인공지능(AI) 가격추적 알고리즘을 이용한 중고자동차의 거래중개컴퓨터, 시스템 및 방법이 제시된다.

KR20260063100.title: AI New car trading brokerage computer using artificial intelligence AI price tracking algorithm and system and method thereof
KR20260063100.abstract: 본 발명에서는, 적어도 하나의 하드웨어 프로세서와 신차 거래 중개 관련 프로그램을 저장한 메모리를 포함하고 온라인 신차 거래를 중개하는 신차거래중개컴퓨터로서, 신차 구매를 원하는 구매자가 제공한 신차 정보를 포함하는 신차 구매 요청 정보를 저장하고, 상기 구매자의 신차 구매 요청 정보를 기초로 인공지능(AI) 가격추적 기반으로 제공되는 신차 관련 가격정보 및 구매시점 정보를 포함하는 가격추적산출 정보를 수신하고, 적어도 하나의 판매자 그룹으로 저장된 판매자들에게 제공한 구매자가 구매 요청한 신차 정보 및 상기 신차 관련 가격추적산출 정보를 기초로 제공하는 신차 견적 정보가 포함된 판매자들의 입찰서를 수신하고, 상기 판매자들의 입찰서 중 하나를 선택하고 선택한 입찰서와 상기 입찰서를 제공한 판매자의 정보를 구매자에게 제공하고, 상기 구매자와 선택된 판매자 간의 신차 매매 계약 정보를 저장하는 것을 특징으로 하는 인공지능(AI) 가격추적 알고리즘을 이용한 신차 거래 중개 컴퓨터, 이를 이용한 시스템 및 방법이 제시된다.

CN121836763.title: Second-hand car price rationality judgment method and product
CN121836763.abstract: The invention discloses a second-hand car price rationality judgment method and a product, and solves the problem that in the prior art, a residual value estimation method based on a car license age limit neglects key factors such as the actual use condition, the color and the region of a car; the dynamic change of the market supply-demand relationship cannot be reflected; the method solves the problems that average value estimation based on similar vehicle prices cannot accurately measure the comprehensive influence of factors such as vehicle conditions on the prices and is easily interfered by abnormal high-price or low-price samples, so that the estimated value is unstable. The method comprises the following steps: S1, acquiring an on-sale second-hand vehicle data set of a target vehicle model; step S2, carrying out normalization processing on the continuous characteristic variables in the data set; s3, training the normalized data set by using a machine learning regression model to obtain a price prediction model; and S4, performing price prediction on a target vehicle by using the price prediction model to obtain a predicted price.

CN121504521.title: Second-hand car price evaluation model training method and device based on deep learning
CN121504521.abstract: The invention discloses a second-hand car price evaluation model training method and device based on deep learning, and the method comprises the steps: obtaining the historical transaction data of a second-hand car, and carrying out the data preprocessing, and obtaining a training sample; selecting samples from the training samples to construct a sample pair of the to-be-evaluated sample and the real sample; respectively inputting the real sample and the to-be-evaluated sample into a first sub-network and a second sub-network of the double-tower model to obtain a first sample vector and a second sample vector; wherein the first sub-network and the second sub-network both adopt a deep cross network architecture; performing element-level product on the first sample vector and the second sample vector to obtain an interactive feature vector, and mapping the interactive feature vector into a scalar through an output layer; all parameters of the double-tower model are updated through back propagation according to the scalar and the loss function of the sample price difference, a trained second-hand car price evaluation model is obtained, and the problems that a second-hand car price prediction method is weak in feature intersection and insufficient in sample relevance utilization are solved.

CN121437074.title: Big data analysis-based car rental automatic price adjustment method
CN121437074.abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of car rental price adjustment, and discloses a car rental automatic price adjustment method based on big data analysis, and the method comprises the following steps: S1, obtaining the user information data of each car rental platform through each platform data collection unit; s2, acquiring vehicle information data of each vehicle model through a vehicle information module; s3, client selection data are acquired through a client selection module; s4, analyzing the user information data, the vehicle information data and the customer selection data through an analysis module, and obtaining the real-time vehicle renting price of each vehicle model of each vehicle renting platform; according to the technical scheme, the price of the same vehicle model can be automatically adjusted according to the vehicle renting platform, the vehicle information data and the user information data without manual operation, the vehicle renting transaction rate is increased, and the after-sales problem caused by errors caused by manual operation is avoided.

CN121391310.title: Second-hand car price prediction method and system
CN121391310.abstract: The invention provides a second-hand vehicle price prediction method and system, and belongs to the technical field of vehicle price evaluation, and the method comprises the steps: obtaining second-hand vehicle transaction data; preprocessing the data, including missing value processing and abnormal value detection and processing, and splitting an integer form date feature into three sub-features of year, month and day; performing feature engineering processing including feature classification, target price variable logarithm transformation and feature selection; training a gradient lifting decision tree model, and applying tree structure pruning parameters and a parallel computing strategy; evaluating model performance; analyzing feature importance by applying an SHAP method; outputting an optimized model and an interpretability analysis result, and reducing the training time by 84% and the model volume by 50% while keeping the prediction precision through a feature selection and model pruning collaborative optimization strategy; a black box problem is solved by introducing an SHAP analysis method, and a visual basis is provided for business decision making; and optimal balance of prediction precision, calculation efficiency and model transparency is realized.
CN121391310.assignee: HANGZHOU CAOHUI NETWORK TECH CO LTD

CN121169435.title: Second-hand car price prediction method based on hybrid model
CN121169435.abstract: The invention discloses a second-hand car price prediction method based on a hybrid model. The second-hand car price prediction method comprises the steps of calculating a brand reputation index, a car rare index and a configuration complexity score through enhanced feature engineering; carrying out price interval classification on the to-be-predicted vehicle by adopting an improved K-nearest neighbor algorithm; according to the price interval, calling a constructed layered random forest model to carry out accurate price prediction; and setting an initial weight based on the price interval, carrying out weighted fusion on prediction results of the K nearest neighbor algorithm and the random forest through a dynamic weight fusion algorithm, and carrying out calculation to obtain a final price prediction value and a confidence interval. According to the method, the calculation efficiency is improved, the prediction precision is remarkably improved, rare vehicle model prediction is highlighted, the robustness is enhanced, and the cost effectiveness is remarkable.
CN121169435.assignee: SUZHOU ZHEYUAN INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

CN121169590.title: Car insurance price processing method and device, computer equipment and storage medium
CN121169590.abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of artificial intelligence, can be applied to business system platforms such as financial science and technology, and discloses a vehicle insurance price processing method and device, computer equipment and a storage medium, and the method comprises the steps: obtaining an impact factor affecting the vehicle insurance price of a target vehicle, and carrying out the preprocessing of the impact factor; wherein the influence factors comprise structured data and text data; performing embedding operation on the preprocessed influence factors to obtain vector representation of the influence factors, and constructing a nonlinear relation of the vector representation; performing feature extraction on the text data to obtain text features, analyzing the text features, and extracting correction coefficients in the text features; using the correction coefficient to correct a prediction result generated by a pre-trained vehicle insurance price prediction model through the vector representation to obtain a vehicle insurance pricing result of the target vehicle; therefore, the accuracy and adaptability of car insurance pricing can be effectively improved.
CN121169590.assignee: PING AN TECH SHENZHEN CO LTD

CN120410682.title: Online car-hailing dynamic price adjustment and order sending method and system, and computer equipment
CN120410682.abstract: The invention provides an online car-hailing dynamic price adjustment and order sending method and system, and computer equipment. The method comprises the steps of obtaining an order receiving mode and driver portrait data set by a driver through a driver end; according to the driver portrait data, the total number of drivers capable of receiving orders in various order receiving modes in the order sending range of the target order is selected; determining an estimated amount type of the target order according to a preset estimated amount type configuration; based on preset price adjustment rules matched with different order receiving time period types, according to the estimated amount type and the total number of drivers capable of receiving orders, determining a final price adjustment multiplying power and a target order sending type of the target order; and sending the target order based on the final price adjustment multiplying power and the target order sending type. According to the invention, the dynamic price adjustment is carried out according to the order receiving mode set by the driver, the problems existing in the peak and the flat period in the prior art are effectively solved by optimizing the order distribution in the peak and setting the price reduction order sending strategy, and the platform operation efficiency, the driver income and the user satisfaction are greatly improved.
CN120410682.assignee: BEIJING XINGYUN ONLINE SOFTWARE DEV CO LTD

CN120181889.title: Dynamic price adjustment method and system in online car-hailing order explosion scene
CN120181889.abstract: The invention relates to the related field of online car-hailing scheduling management, and discloses a dynamic price adjustment method and system in an online car-hailing order-exploding scene, which perform price increase coefficient calculation through indexes of real-time big data statistics, refine to a honeycomb dimension, solve the problem that the price increase of the whole city is not fine enough, and improve the price increase efficiency. Meanwhile, the price increase coefficient is dynamically adjusted through the driver busy degree, and the problem that manual setting of the price adjustment coefficient is unreasonable is effectively solved.

WO2025116072.title: SYSTÈME DE DÉTERMINATION DE PRIX DE VOITURES DE LOCATION
WO2025116072.abstract: The present invention relates to a rental car price determination system and, more specifically, to a rental car price determination system in which: a rental car use rate is predicted by analyzing a correlation between a use rate of rental cars and a reservation rate of accommodations in a tourist destination, and a rental car price is determined according to the predicted use rate, so that it is possible to determine a reasonable rental car price; and the rental car price is adjusted and provided in accordance with a rental car use state, a driving habit of a rental car reservation holder, a price change degree of nearby rental car companies, and whether a system-linked tourism product, etc. is purchased, so that the rationality of the rental car price can be increased.
